content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a declaration of the variable `j` that was too close to its point of use within the function `execcw`. Initially, `j` was declared within the scope of a loop where it was being used, but the declaration needed to be moved outside the loop to maintain its value across multiple iterations of the `while` loop. This mishandling of variable scope led to unintended behavior in the code, causing a coloring bug when the value of `j` was not preserved as expected.
